component.name: Web Label Printer
component.summary: Design and print labels for Phomemo thermal printers

description.p: A multiplatform application for designing and printing labels specifically for Phomemo Q30/D30 series Bluetooth thermal printers.

ul.li: Object-based canvas with full manipulation (move, scale, rotate, align)
Integrated icon library with over 200,000 icons
Professional typography with Google Fonts and built-in font library
Precision tools with visual grid and smart alignment
Template system for saving and loading label designs
